title: Chapter 1391 - 10: Tianyuan, Come Out And Face Your Death
content:
Chapter 1391 - 10: Tianyuan, Come Out And Face Your Death

Chapter 1391: Chapter 10: Tianyuan, Come Out and Face Your Death

Undying substance, also known as longevity substance, is a special material that Emperor level experts in this Fang Yuan World crave intensely.

Not only can it allow one’s own transformation to the extreme, but more importantly, it can also extend life span.

It is said that in the distant past, the undying substance was extremely abundant in the world, giving birth to one supreme emperor after another.

These emperors absorbed a large amount of undying substance, extending their life span far beyond a million years, with combat power so strong that it could nearly shake the Red Dust Immortals.

Within the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, gazing with astonishment at the strand of undying substance in front of him, seemingly tangible.

Condensing this strand of undying substance took Lin Yuan more than a day’s effort.

Yet it surpassed the amount of undying substance accumulated by Emperor Tianyuan over two million years.

Throughout the generations, the undying substance condensed by past emperors might not even compare to the current strand.

In Lin Yuan’s view, this strand of undying substance before him was composed of countless microscopic particles.

Each particle was interwoven with thirty-three basic units, forming a stable shape.

Numerous such microscopic particles combined to form this strand of undying substance.

"Amazing."

Lin Yuan exclaimed with awe that this strand of undying substance had profoundly impacted him.

The thirty-three basic units interweaving to form an extremely stable balance.

"Absorbing the undying substance will cause the fundamental composition of one’s body and soul to transform into this particle form, becoming much stronger than the original physique."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Simultaneously, many pieces of information flashed through his mind.

In the distant past, when the undying substance was extremely abundant, it gave birth to supreme emperors capable of shaking the Red Dust Immortals.

Red Dust Immortals, marked against the thirteenth tier of time life.

Supreme emperors still at the twelfth tier level.

Twelfth tier shaking the thirteenth tier?

Lin Yuan couldn’t fathom, except for himself.

How other life forms were able to accomplish this feat.

Yet in this Fang Yuan World, Lin Yuan saw the possibility.

That is the undying substance.

As long as one absorbs enough undying substance.

Even if still at the twelfth tier, the body and soul will transform towards the time life form.

Finally, as long as one’s acquired Dao or legacy reaches the threshold.

A scene indeed could appear where supreme emperors shake the Red Dust Immortals.

"This Fang Yuan World?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly.

Realizing where the greatest value of this Fang Yuan World lay for him.

Undying substance.

The essence of this special material is incredibly high.

And it has almost no hidden dangers or side effects on life’s transformation.

Even without navigating time cycles, absorbing enough undying material.

One could forcibly uplift one’s body and soul to approach the time life’s domain.

"Laying the foundation for body and soul with this undying substance, then restoring to thirteenth-tier strength, what level will my prowess reach?"

Lin Yuan was full of vigor.

By then, with a perfect and flawless physique, as long as he comprehends the Chaos Taiji Origin Dao, he could step into the thirteenth tier Second Realm.

A thirteenth tier Second Realm Lin Yuan, relying on his numerous foundations, in addition to the fundamental particle form transformed by undying material, likely could grapple with an ordinary Time Lord.

"Continue."

Lin Yuan calmed his thoughts, dividing half his mind to continue condensing the undying substance between heaven and earth.

As for the remaining half of his mind, he began refining the newly condensed undying substance.

Bzz bzz bzz~ As the undying substance merged, Lin Yuan immediately felt that his fundamental particle form was beginning to change, from the simplest single particle form to the thirty-three basic unit form.

Thirty-three basic units forming a particle, the stability of such a particle far surpassed the previous one.

"First, I will explore the path after refining the undying substance with this body. If indeed there are no hidden dangers, I will replicate it on the other three true forms."

Lin Yuan felt the surge of energy within his body and rapidly pondered in his mind.

The so-called change of the undying substance on the most basic particles of the body and soul equates to a forcible guidance.

As long as Lin Yuan comprehends the principle, even without the undying substance forcibly guiding, he can replicate it on other true forms.

...

Time passed.

In a blink, ten years had gone by.

Lin Yuan remained sitting cross-legged in the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, hardly different from ten years ago.

Yet fundamentally, Lin Yuan had undergone a earth-shattering transformation. Over the decade of continuously condensing strands of undying substance, under the baptism of a large amount of undying substance, one-tenth of Lin Yuan’s body physique and soul had completely transformed into the form of undying substance.

"What’s my current strength?"

Lin Yuan slowly stood up, pacing casually within the Emperor Palace.

It was the first time in a decade that Lin Yuan actively got up.

"I feel, with merely transforming one-tenth of my body physique, my combat power was squeezed into the level of time life, stronger than the supreme emperors in the legends."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

The same process of refining undying substance, those emperors refined it in an extremely simplistic way, even the strongest supreme emperors only roughly refined the undying substance.

But Lin Yuan? As a life of time, he naturally knew how to refine it properly.

Past emperors merely refined a little here and there, yet Lin Yuan refined from the foundation bit by bit.

Therefore, even by transforming just one-tenth of his body physique, he had already surpassed the supreme emperors.

"In truth, now I am no different from the so-called Red Dust Immortals."

Lin Yuan pondered to himself.

With body, physique, and soul all stepping into the thirteenth tier level, his mind and will also being those of a life of time, able to freely view future timelines.
